chapter: Listening to the Troy Floyd records
title: Cy Kye's soprano sax, Dixon on tuba, and one-mic recording
summary: Albert praises Cy Kye on soprano sax and Charlie Dixon on tuba, notes he plays the segments behind the reeds, and says a single mic limited the instrumentation heard. Everything was voiced by ear.
